_comment: Maintained FOMC/CPI/PCE/GDP schedule for the event-risk module. These dates are FEED-REQUIRED and must be verified against primary sources (federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar, bls.gov CPI schedule, bea.gov), NEVER inferred from a formula (MARKET_STRUCTURE.md §6.3). Copy to instance/events.json (gitignored) and keep current. FOMC = Fed decision day (2nd day of meeting); CPI = BLS release day. Verified 2026-05-30 from federalreserve.gov and BLS.
